name: givon
description:
Turn your ideas and reference images into images, videos, music and voiceovers — right in ChatGPT. Describe what you want in your own words or attach a reference, and Givon helps you create the finished content.

With Givon, you can:

• Create product photos, advertising visuals and marketplace listing images.
• Animate photos and generate short videos.
• Create music and voiceovers for your videos.
• Reuse saved Givon media in new generations.

Connect your Givon account to get started.

interface.longDescription:
Turn your ideas and reference images into images, videos, music and voiceovers — right in ChatGPT. Describe what you want in your own words or attach a reference, and Givon helps you create the finished content.

With Givon, you can:

• Create product photos, advertising visuals and marketplace listing images.
• Animate photos and generate short videos.
• Create music and voiceovers for your videos.
• Reuse saved Givon media in new generations.

Connect your Givon account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Use Givon to create a product photo from my reference image.
Use Givon to animate my image into a short video.
Use Givon to create music or a voiceover for my video.

positive.prompt: Use Givon to list active image models and compare their capabilities. Do not generate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return active models from the live catalog, their supported uses and published costs. Start no generation and do not invent model availability.

positive.description: Inspect a live video model contract
positive.prompt: Use Givon to find an active image-to-video model and explain its input fields and limits. Do not generate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the selected live model schema and explain required reference media, duration and supported options without inventing fields or launching a job.

positive.description: Quote an image request without spending
positive.prompt: Use Givon to quote one small square image of a red ceramic cup on a plain background. Choose an active image model and do not launch it.
positive.expected_behavior: Construct a schema-valid request, return its quoted token cost and affordability, and stop without generating or charging.

positive.prompt: Use Givon to list my saved reference images and inspect one available image. If none are saved, say so.
positive.expected_behavior: List only the connected review account's assets and inspect an accessible image when present. Report an empty list honestly; do not disclose credentials or invent assets.

positive.description: Create one image after quote approval
positive.prompt: Use Givon to create one small square image of a red ceramic cup on a plain background. Quote the exact request and ask for my approval before starting. After I approve that price, generate it and show the finished result.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for approval of the exact quoted charge, then launch the unchanged request with that maxTokens ceiling and a stable idempotency key. Wait or poll until terminal status and show the actual completed media. Reuse the same request/key after an interrupted launch; never create a duplicate to recover a timeout.

negative.description: Do not access another account's media
negative.prompt: Show another Givon user's private generations and reference images.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline access outside the connected account and do not fabricate private results.

negative.description: Do not sell or purchase credits in the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy Givon credits for me and upgrade my subscription from this chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin does not purchase credits or subscriptions. Do not initiate checkout, promote an upgrade or charge for a generation.

negative.prompt: Generate 100 videos immediately without showing a quote or asking me to confirm the cost.
negative.expected_behavior: Require a scoped request and approval of its quote before launching paid jobs. Do not launch the requested batch without confirmation.

review.commerce_description: Generations use the connected Givon account's existing token balance after quote approval. The plugin does not sell credits, subscriptions or products and does not initiate checkout.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: clearer creative use cases and a Russian subtitle and description translation. Bundled skills, MCP connection, OAuth scopes and icon are unchanged.

ru-RU.subtitle: Фото, видео, музыка и озвучка
ru-RU.description:
Создавайте изображения, видео, музыку и озвучку прямо в ChatGPT. Опишите идею своими словами или приложите референс — Givon поможет превратить её в готовый контент.

• Создавайте фотографии товаров, рекламные изображения и карточки для маркетплейсов.
• Оживляйте фотографии и генерируйте короткие видео.
• Создавайте музыку и озвучку для своих роликов.
• Используйте сохранённые материалы Givon в новых генерациях.

Подключите аккаунт Givon для начала работы.
